|birth = 894 NE|build = Stocky|hair = Black|eyes = Dark brown}}'''Annharid Matoun''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Yellow Ajah]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Annharid Matoun}}

== Appearance and Personality ==
She is about 5'5" tall, with coppery skin, dark brown eyes and black hair. She is a little stocky, but not heavy.

A forceful woman, not particularly arrogant for a Yellow, but strong-willed and determined, she did not suffer fools gladly

== Strength and Abilities ==
Annharid is [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|strong]] for an Aes Sedai, with a [[One Power]] level of {{opsl|23}}. She is strong enough to be able to [[Traveling|Travel]].

Being of the Yellow Ajah also means that she has some skill with [[Healing]].

== History ==
Annharid was born in {{ne|894}} and went to the [[White Tower]] in [[909 NE]]. After spending eight years as a [[novice]] and six years as [[Accepted]], she was raised to the shawl in {{ne|923}}.

==Activities==
She has allied herself with the [[Salidar Aes Sedai]] and is one of the [[Rebel Spies]] sent back to the White Tower to spread the rumor that the [[Red Ajah]] set [[Logain]] up as a [[False Dragon]]{{ref/book|7|8}}.

[[Zerah Dacan]] betrayed her unwillingly, along with the other spies, when she was questioned by [[Pevara Tazanovni]] and [[Seaine Herimon]]{{ref/book|8|26}}.

[[Celestin]] is currently working with Annharid on [[Yukiri]]'s orders as a result of this to find more about [[Atuan Larisett]]'s friends in order to see who else might be members of her [[Heart]]{{ref/book|10|p}}.

When [[Meidani Eschede|Meidani]] is freed from her oath of obedience, it can be assumed Annharid was as well.
